$comment: Tree pipeline config (docs/tree-placement-workflow.md, .claude/agents/tree-placement.md). Bro Hof Slott: two 18-hole routings (The Stadium Course, The Castle Course) on one ground, the pipeline's third ground and the first whose window holds two laser campaigns (laser.parts).

window.note: a 2,048 m square on the published ground's 256 m finest-tile edges (8 x 8 tiles round the frame origin E 649094.5 N 6598568.5), holding all 36 holes, the range, the practice areas and their 90 m play zone

laser.label: 20C028 2020-11-06 and 21C031 2021-03-23, leaf-off

parts.label: 20C028 2020-11-06 leaf-off
parts.note: west of E 650000: 94% of the inner window

parts.label: 21C031 2021-03-23 leaf-off
parts.note: the 118.5 m strip east of E 650000: 6% of the inner window

laser.note: Laserdata Nedladdning, skog (dsm-skoglig-copc), 2.5 km items; the newest campaign per area in the pinned inventory of 2026-11-24. Two campaigns meet in the window at E 650000 (laser.parts): 20C028, flown 2020-11-06 (late leaf fall: birch and aspen bare, some oak and alder may still hold leaves), and 21C031, flown 2021-03-23. The pin's two northern items (21C037, 21C038) lie north of N 6600000, outside the halo window (N 6599652.5), and are not read. No growing season lies between the two flights.

notFetched.other years: orto-o2-2021 (leaf-off) is the leaf-off campaign nearest both laser flights and orto-o2-2025 the newest leaf-on one; no other orthophoto year was fetched

published.baselineNote: the machine-v1 first generation as the live root served it when the candidates were built (2026-11-24 22:46). The live root was re-promoted several times by another session during this review (ground-v2-9ba61580, 7f773bf1, bf788372: the same terrain and surface chunks in all 469 tiles, at most 1 object and 14 stand chunks apart); the candidates were built against a private copy of it. The canopy and detect stages read 9ba61580, the benchmark 7f773bf1.

playZone.note: the app zone A (main.js LEGACY_ZONE_A_METRES) from every hole line and practice area of both routings

rounds.note: round 1: the type-aware detector, tuned on the calibration windows only by scripts/tune-reduced.mjs (the pipeline's SEARCH from the best of four settings, split searched once; the full --tune was started twice and stopped unfinished for time, with no lock and nothing scored). The refined round the windows file also declares was not run, for time; the held-out windows were scored with this lock alone, so they are spent: a later round needs a new unseen sample.

typeRule.note: Johannesberg rule, rechecked on this ground: no calibration reference conifer lies below 0.2 in the April 2021 share (the lowest of 115 matched crowns is 0.286) and 107 of 127 broadleaves do; held out, 1 of 139 conifers (a shaded one, 0.145) and 97 of 124 broadleaves do. Norrfällsviken addition: a broadleaf call also needs a crown in leaf in June 2025 (share 0.15 or more). Park trees over green lawn read as vegetated in April and become unknown, not conifer, below the logistic conifer call; the species spot check on the photos was NOT done.

bank.note: Johannesberg's bank rule (round 5): a crown centroid over mapped water, a path, a road or a played surface gets a stem on its own laser crown's land side, never on a building

holds.note: the pole-like hold and the bank rule as at Johannesberg and Norrfällsviken; held crowns are decided on the photo chips

publication.reviewStatement: reviewed candidates, review-2026-11-24 round r1: the type-aware laser detector (20C028 of 2020-11-06 west of E 650000, 21C031 of 2021-03-23 east of it), tuned with a reduced search on the calibration windows only. The 90% held-out gate is MISSED: on 166 unseen reference crowns P 0.784 / R 0.807 / F1 0.795; the machine-v1 first generation (records and stand trees) scores P 0.662 / R 0.530 / F1 0.589 on the same sample. Agent-led reference interpretation (Claude), not a survey; mostly conifers and separate crowns, closed leafless broadleaf stands are not measured. Crowns leaning over mapped water, paths, roads and played surfaces given a stem on the bank inside their own laser crown (holds.bank); 392 crowns the June 2025 photo does not show removed by a mechanical screen spot-checked by the agent; every felling-screened, pole-like, no-vegetation and on-building crown is held, unreviewed, and not placed; broadleaf only where the April 2021 crown is leafless and the June 2025 crown in leaf, not spot-checked; no GPU photo detector and no human review
